description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sitinamaluwa, Beliattha D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 830116
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including specific determinations of land ownership, parcel numbers, boundaries, and encumbrances for multiple land plots in Sitinamaluwa.
